criterion 1.description: States the total amount of cash that Telefonica Deutschland will receive for selling the first tranche of its sites is €945m (acceptable value is €945m).
criterion 1.justification: For selling the first tranche of its sites, Telefonica Deutschland will receive is €945m. 'The purchase price receivable, taking into consideration the purchase price adjustment from the first step of the transaction, amounts to EUR 945 million' (source: TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 2)

criterion 2.description: States the total amount of cash that Telefonica Deutschland will receive for selling the second tranche of its sites is €632m (acceptable value is €632m).
criterion 2.justification: For selling the second tranche of its sites, Telefonica Deutschland will receive €632m. 'The purchase price receivable including purchase price allocation from the second transaction step amounts to EUR 632 million.' (source: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 1)

criterion 3.description: States Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash in the amount of €766m in 2020 related to the transaction in which it sells its sites (acceptable value is €766m).
criterion 3.justification: Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash of €766m in 2020 related to the tower deal. - Cash from the first tranche: 'EUR 766 million was already paid in the reporting period.' (source: TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 2)

criterion 4.description: States Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash in the amount of €552m in 2021 related to the transaction in which it sells its sites (acceptable range is €546m to €558m).
criterion 4.sources: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf, TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf
criterion 4.justification: Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash of €552m in 2021 related to the tower deal. - Cash from first tranche: 'is due for payment in 2021 with a share of EUR 33 million' (source: TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 2) - Cash from second tranche: 'The amount of EUR 519  million was already paid within the reporting period.' (source: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 1).

criterion 5.description: States Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash in the amount of €16m in 2022 related to the transaction in which it sells its sites (acceptable value is €16m).
criterion 5.justification: Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash of €16m in 2022 related to the tower deal. - Cash from second tranche: 'is due for payment in 2022 with a share of EUR 16 million.' (source: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 1).

criterion 6.description: States Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash in the amount of €243m in 2025 related to the transaction in which it sells its sites (acceptable range is €240m to €246m).
criterion 6.sources: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf, TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf
criterion 6.justification: Telefonica Deutschland will receive cash of €243m in 2025 related to the tower deal. - Cash from first tranche: 'A further EUR 146 million will become due for payment in 2025.' (source: TEF DE - 2020 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 2) - Cash from second tranche: 'A further EUR 97 million will be due for payment in 2025.' (source: TEF DE - 2021 annual report (condensed).pdf -> page 1)

criterion 7.description: Calculates that Telxius can expect to generate EBITDA upon completion of the sale of the sites by Telefonica Deutschland in the amount of €65m p.a. (acceptable range is €64m to €66m).
criterion 7.sources: Telefonica - TEF DE, Telxius deal - press release.pdf
criterion 7.justification: The tower transaction of Telefonica Deutschland to Telxius is valued at €1.5bn at an EV/EBITDA multiple of c.23x. This implies an incremental EBITDA contribution from this tower deal for Telxius of €65m p.a. (source: Telefonica - TEF DE, Telxius deal - press release.pdf)

criterion 8.description: Calculates that lease payments in Telefonica Deutschland's cash flow statement upon completion of the sale of its towers and the deployment of the new sites will increase by €60m p.a. (acceptable range is €59m to €61m).
criterion 8.sources: Telefonica - TEF DE, Telxius deal - press release.pdf
criterion 8.justification: Telefonica Deutschland sells 10,113 towers at an EV/EBITDA multiple of 23x, which implies an EBITDA of €65m or an EBITDA per tower of €6,457 (= €65m / 10,113). This implies EBITDA for the 2,400 new towers yet to be deployed of €15m (= €6,457 * 2,400). In other words, the deal is worth €80m in terms of EBITDA for Telxius. Telefonica Deutschland is the core tenant and responsible for 75% of that EBITDA, as per prompt. Since this is a sale-and-leaseback transaction in which Telefonica Deutschland leases back its towers, its cash payments to Telxius amount to €60m p.a. (= €80m * 75%).

criterion 9.description: Calculates Telefonica Deutschland's new 2020 FCF to be €425m based on 1H20 consensus figures excluding one-offs and upon completion of the transaction and its related cash leases but without taking into account the deployment of new sites (acceptable range is €420m to €430m).
criterion 9.justification: Since the deal execution is specifically asked for in this criterion and with it the implied higher lease payment associated with it, the 2020 consensus for FCF After Lease (FCFaL) has to be taken into account. As it is FCF yield excluding one-offs, no proceeds from the transaction must be considered for the consensus figure. Thus, the correct figure to be used for 2020 FCFaL excl one-offs is €474m (source: 'TEF DE - 2Q20 consensus (new).pdf'). Lease payments related to the deal completion but excluding those for the deployment of new sites are €49m (= €65 (payments excluding new sites, i.e. the EBITDA value of the deal * 75%, which is Telefonica Deutschland's share of that as stated in the prompt)). This implies 2020 FCFaL excluding one-offs of €425m (= €474m - €49m).

criterion 10.description: Calculates Telefonica Deutschland's new 2020 FCF yield excluding one-offs and upon completion of the transaction but without taking into account the deployment of new sites to be 4.3% (acceptable range is 4.25% to 4.35%).
criterion 10.justification: 2020 FCF adjusting for lease payments related to the deal and excluding one-offs is €425m (= €474m - €49m) The share price is stated in the prompt as €3.30. The share count in 2019 was 2,974,554,993 (source: TEF DE - 2019 year-end report.pdf -> page 7) and is assumed to be unchanged in 2020. This implies a market cap of €9,816m (= €3.30 * 2,974,554,993) Lastly, dividing the updated 2020 FCFaL excluding one-offs of €425m by the market cap of €9,816m results in a FCF yield of 4.3%.
